steps.text: Move the mouse over the sidebar to expand it: the notification bell appears.
steps.title: Expand the sidebar

steps.text: Click the bell in the sidebar to open the notifications panel. The invitation to join the community appears here, with the community name and when it was received.
steps.title: Open notifications

steps.text: Tap the bell to open the notifications panel. The invitation to join the community appears here.
steps.title: Open notifications

steps.text: Open the page that lists all your notifications.
steps.title: All notifications

steps.text: The notifications page gathers all of your notifications. The invitation to join the community appears here, with the community name and the date it was received.
steps.title: View the notifications page
